comparison.objective: Measure two level scoops of powdered formula into a bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular scooping, leveling against a bar, controlled pouring into a narrow neck, and dose control.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle receives 16.6–19.1 g from two bar-leveled scoops, with spill and scoop-release requirements; heaped or unlevelled delivery fails.
comparison.reason: Dose measurement and scoop leveling do not test size-selective passage of free rigid bodies through a screen or retained-workpiece control. No comparison-critical detail is missing.
